verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scheduling recurring jobs or workflows on a time-based cadence. Triggers are event-driven ('watches for something to happen'), and batch calls are one-off CSV campaign launches, so neither is a recurring schedule. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: A trigger watches for something to happen and acts on it.
Batch calls let you initiate high-volume call campaigns by uploading a list of recipients via CSV.
